name: Growing Maze
desc: A perfect maze carves itself in real time via randomized recursive-backtracker growth, the hot carving head snaking corridor by corridor through the grid until a glowing solver floods the solution path, then it dissolves and a fresh maze grows — rendered as a cool neon circuit board, a technical blueprint, a red Ariadne thread on cream, a sunlit hedge garden, or a torch-lit dungeon.

density.doc: grid fineness / maze complexity (more cells = tighter maze)

energy.doc: glow / bloom amplitude on carving head, solver & sparkles

speed.doc: carve rate, solve reveal & pulse speed

hue.doc: cool wall/trace base hue (circuit ground + corridors)

style.doc: render philosophy: neon line / schematic / ink thread / hedge mass / stone mass

alpha.doc: opacity for VJ compositing (100 = opaque bg)
